subject.title: [Feature]: WebUI notification system, cron job management popups, and context monitor integration

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared Control UI in-app notification/action queue for cron results and context pressure, and should related WebChat action surfaces share that contract?
rationale: Current main has partial cron, Web Push, and context-monitoring pieces, but the remaining request changes Control UI product architecture and overlaps other open notification/action work.

options.title: Design Shared UI Notifications First
options.body: Add a single Control UI notification/action contract and then implement cron-result and context-pressure actions on top of it.

options.title: Fold Into WebChat Actions
options.body: Treat this as part of the broader webchat inline button/callback action contract so chat, cron, and notification actions share one callback path.

options.title: Defer In-App Popups
options.body: Keep the issue open but limit current product support to existing inline context warnings, cron history, and Web Push settings until a larger notification roadmap is chosen.

recommendation.title: Design Shared UI Notifications First
recommendation.body: Add a single Control UI notification/action contract and then implement cron-result and context-pressure actions on top of it.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses cron gateway behavior, notification delivery, and product UX boundaries where steipete has the strongest recent history signal.
